title: PresenceCacheResource.record() does not validate time_source() output
description: In PresenceCacheResource.record() at line 258-260, the ts parameter is validated with _finite_non_negative(), but now from self._time_source() is not validated. If time_source() returns NaN or a negative value: 1) min(stamp, nan) returns nan in Python, 2) NaN gets stored in self._nodes[addr]['ts'], 3) Later calls to snapshot() invoke age_s_at() which validates the stored ts and raises PresenceError. This corrupts the cache with no recovery path. The __init__ validates time_source() at construction but not on subsequent calls. Fix: validate now with _finite_non_negative before using it in the min() call.
